RoleFacilityAccessRight * -- 1 FacilityA Facility has some RoleFacilityAccessRights. It can have none, and there is no upper bound defined.A RoleFacilityAccessRight has A Facility. It must always have exactly, one, and can never have none. And there is an upper bound of at most one Facility.When a RoleFacilityAccessRight is created, its Facility must be assigned. When a RoleFacilityAccessRight is deleted, its Facility is not deleted and its list of RoleFacilityAccessRights is decreased. When a Facility is deleted, its RoleFacilityAccessRights are not deleted. They are assigned to another Facility.
